title: Pin bootstrap parent-domain incompatibilities and recover missing source
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Records a source-pinned negative interface result: the proposed bootstrap-control campaign prefix cannot use the unchanged production parent/receiver/domain path. The parent requires its original driver, 26-file/two-build receiver and empty stderr; domain terminal facts require returncode 0, the process has a four-domain limit, and closure census/binding/literal rules constrain a successor. The copied-native route also requires fresh file-backed mappings in the copied view.

This 32-file package recovers 11 inert source/readiness copies and checks 14 AST-located anchors plus 4 literal bindings. It is a **source audit**, not a new control supervisor, original execution, completion of compiler-input closure or the bootstrap-control campaign, measured speedup or κ result.

## Task and overlap

Original source investigation: [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Frozen H25 benchmark: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Immediate predecessor: [PR #6362](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6362).

User-assigned original compiler-input closure and the full named bootstrap-control campaign under the portable-replay task. Scope changed from integration construction to the concrete source-gate audit when the actual parent interface failed that gate; the original completion objective and all production checks remain unchanged.

Base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; published head `a8cf650b7435ccea237084e491e339f725c0a35b`; tree `656fa658961baf6b38443b81a343dbfc34e33da6` matches byte-checked local commit528e7c81f10792d664cb8095db0c92052c4e6bf0.

Canonical thread #6321. #6352 (`b280be8dab15359159538e639b1d8c7deafc0612`) supplied prior entry/parent questions; #6362 (`120072d58ddb46f0e02886756243174d41fce42e`) implemented partial input-edge/prefix/data helpers. This audit adds actual recovered parent/domain/closure/epoch/supervisor source and the consequent incompatibilities, rather than treating a generic “genuine parent” as implemented.

The refreshed 23-node bounded PR metadata graph is in evidence/PR-COVERAGE.json. This also corrects a delivery gap: the earlier PR6362 prompt/body referred to a PR-COVERAGE file that was local session material and was not exported there. Current PR metadata is distinct from full current-head source review.

## Validation

Executed locally with Python 3.12:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-c05-v03-parent-interface-audit --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-c05-v03-parent-interface-audit
python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/h25-c05-v03-parent-interface-audit
```

All passed for the final adjusted export. The registered command authenticates archive bytes and checks source structure/anchors only. It never imports archived originals or runs original Root/provider/parent/native/compiler/namespace work. Metadata scaffold failures are retained. Independent Sol Max source and export review accepted the narrowed findings after correcting anonymous-mapping and literal-registry scope wording. Hosted results are pending submission.

The parent-interface audit closed at its 15-minute source gate before implementation; publication is a separate disposition. The subsequent Pro consultation completed and identifies same-build generated GCC plugin data as the next distinct dependency. Full compiler-input closure and the bootstrap-control campaign remain false. The original budget was not expanded; guard debit 94.550533479/2400 is not full physical cost. Outside preparation/review/publication/final costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO. App goal separately observed paused.

## Credit

Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial ChatGPT Pro/Codex/Sol Max assistance and independent agent review. Retain original source authors, PR6321/6029/5864 lineage, unpaidmoon/Cursor Grok for PR #6339 and Douglas R. Colkitt's native/circuit/verification lineage. Inert sources retain notices; new verification/archive code Apache-2.0. Agent/source/archive review is distinct from human, native and original scientific acceptance.

## Open next questions

See the package README. Construct and independently review a separate control-only supervisor/terminal accessor and clean authenticated bootstrap while preserving original production acceptance, actual Popen/domain/error/raw ownership and original caps. Separately finish actual compiler configuration/query closure and immutable witness interval before original stage/command/funding/execution admission. No lease, serialized capability, registry reset or production-completion mint can replace those requirements.
